node.title: PMA stage 1: mixed-petal extras = RS list of the auxiliary pieced word (one level down)
node.statement: Fix defect set D (|D| = d) and background R_P. Non-planted extras inject (P -> W_P, proved unique) into the list of degree-<=d polynomials agreeing with the auxiliary word U*(x) = c_i L_D(x) on T_i (well-defined: petals disjoint) at agreement N = d+1+sigma-|R_P|, with W = 0 on R_P. The D-choice entropy C(k-1,d) is charged to the reserve — the same budget line as all locator combinatorics.
node.notes: elementary from the PROVED core-defect lemma; turns the amplification problem into list decoding at degree d | IN FLIGHT: #197 | FLIP on replay (Codex wave 5): PROVABLE -> PROVED.
